ActivityMessage.title: ActivityMessage
ActivityMessage.description:
Structured progress that is not conversation content, materialised as a
message so it keeps its place in the sequence. Stands alone rather than
composing BaseMessage, because its content is an object rather than a
string.

AssistantMessage.title: AssistantMessage
AssistantMessage.description:
A message from the agent. Content is optional because a turn may consist
only of tool calls.

BudgetChange.title: BudgetChange
BudgetChange.description: A monthly limit, in major units (USD).

CategoryRead.title: CategoryRead
CategoryRead.description: A category as other code sees it: a frozen copy, never the table row.

message.title: Message
examples: I spent 25 on lunch at Subway today, paid by card

Context.title: Context
Context.description:
A named piece of ambient information given to the agent for the run,
distinct from the conversation.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Major-unit magnitude formatted to `currency`'s minor-unit precision.

ExpenseChanges.title: ExpenseChanges
ExpenseChanges.description: The body of PATCH /expenses/{id}: send only the fields you want to change.

ExpenseRead.title: ExpenseRead
ExpenseRead.description: An expense as callers see it: everything stored, plus the amount in major units for display.

FileSource.title: FileSource
FileSource.description:
Bytes already at the provider, named by a handle the provider issued: an
OpenAI or Anthropic file id, a Gemini file URI, a storage URL only that
provider can read. No bytes travel and nothing is fetched. Only the
provider that minted the handle can resolve it; a peer that cannot drops
the part as it drops any part it cannot use.

FunctionCall.title: FunctionCall
FunctionCall.description: The name and arguments of a tool call.

Language.title: Language
Language.description: A language, by its BCP 47 code: what the web app sends in Accept-Language.

net.title: Net
net.description: Signed major-unit net balance (+ means owed money, - means owes money).

NewExpense.title: NewExpense
NewExpense.description: A new expense. Also the body of POST /expenses.

owed_to_you.title: Owed To You
owed_to_you.description: Major-unit sum of obligations owed to you in `currency`.

you_owe.title: You Owe
you_owe.description: Major-unit sum of obligations you owe in `currency`.

text.title: Text
examples: Paid 24.50 at Corner Bistro yesterday by card

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The amount as a plain number string, e.g. "1250.50", with no currency symbol or commas. null if the text does not state an amount. Never guess an amount.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code (such as USD, EUR or GBP). Use the default currency from the instructions unless another currency is clearly stated.

category.title: Category
category.description: The best matching category from the allowed list, or null if none fits.

merchant.title: Merchant
merchant.description: The shop, company or person paid, or null if not mentioned.

spent_on.title: Spent On
spent_on.description: The date of the expense. Work out words like 'yesterday' or 'last Friday' from today's date; use today if no date is mentioned.

payment_method.description: Only if the text says how it was paid (card, bank transfer, cash, digital wallet like Apple Pay/PayPal, or UPI apps like GPay/PhonePe); otherwise null.

note.title: Note
note.description: A few words on what was bought, or null.

ParsedExpense.title: ParsedExpense
ParsedExpense.description: One expense read from a short note the user wrote. Use null for anything the note does not say.

ReasoningMessage.title: ReasoningMessage
ReasoningMessage.description:
A span of the agent's reasoning, materialised as a message. Stands alone
rather than composing BaseMessage, because it carries no name.

ResumeEntry.title: ResumeEntry
ResumeEntry.description: An answer to one interrupt, sent on the run that continues from it.

RunAgentInput.title: RunAgentInput
RunAgentInput.description:
A request to run an agent. Also echoed back as RUN_STARTED.input. Only
threadId, runId and messages are required: those are the three the SDKs
already agree on, and for tools and context an absent key and an empty
array mean the same thing, so requiring them would catch nothing a
producer could get wrong.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Total split amount in major units.

my_share.title: My Share
my_share.description: Caller's own share in major units (0 if caller is not a participant).

share.title: Share
share.description: Major-unit share formatted to `currency`'s minor-unit precision.

ThreadMessage.title: ThreadMessage
ThreadMessage.description: One message of a conversation, made readable.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: A tool the agent may call.

ToolCall.title: ToolCall
ToolCall.description:
A call an assistant message made. Carries no subagent attribution of its
own and inherits its containing message's, since several calls can share
one parent.

ToolCallSummary.title: ToolCallSummary
ToolCallSummary.description: One tool the agent ran while answering: what it called, with which arguments, and whether it worked.

ToolMessage.title: ToolMessage
ToolMessage.description:
What a tool returned, as a message in the conversation. Stands alone
rather than composing BaseMessage, because it carries no name.

UrlSource.title: UrlSource
UrlSource.description: Bytes referenced by URL, fetched by whoever needs them.

UserMessage.title: UserMessage
UserMessage.description: A message from the person using the application.
